fact: Vinson & Elkins LLP was founded in 1917 in Houston, Texas by Judge James A. Elkins and William A. Vinson
Headquarters: Texas Tower, Downtown Houston, Texas
Vinson & Elkins employs more than 700 lawyers worldwide across 14 offices
More than 400 of V&E's lawyers work on energy-related legal matters
Chair: Keith Fullenweider (Houston), effective January 1, 2022
US offices: Houston, Austin, Dallas, Denver, Los Angeles, New York, Richmond, San Francisco, Washington DC
International offices: Brussels, Dubai, Dublin, London, Riyadh, Tokyo
2023 gross revenue: $1.13 billion — first year the firm crossed the $1 billion threshold; ranked No. 54 on Am Law 100
2023 profit per equity partner (PEP): $4.51 million (up 12.3% year-over-year)
Ranked the top law firm in Texas by Vault for 10 consecutive years (as of 2026 survey)
Ranked the top law firm for Energy, Oil & Gas by Vault for 13 consecutive years (as of 2026 survey)
Recognized by Euromoney Magazine as 'The World's Leading Energy Law Firm' continuously since 1995
Chambers & Partners USA 2026: 66 ranked departments and 141 ranked individuals
Named 2024 Best Corporate Practice in Energy by The American Lawyer
First-year associate base salary: $225,000 (Cravath scale-aligned)
Associate salary scale: 1st yr $225K / 2nd $235K / 3rd $260K / 4th $310K / 5th $365K / 6th $390K / 7th $420K / 8th $435K
Summer associate compensation: $4,327/week for a 10-week program
Associates must log 1,900 billable hours to be bonus-eligible
Conducts OCIs at Boston College, Boston University, Columbia, Cornell, George Washington, Georgetown, NYU, and UC Law San Francisco
Hired 24 lateral associates in 2024
Firm lawyers contribute approximately 20,000 hours of pro bono legal service per year; average ~30 hours per US attorney
In January 2022, V&E became founding sponsor of the University of Texas School of Law Pipeline Program with a $1 million commitment
During the Enron scandal, V&E was Enron's primary outside counsel; Enron represented approximately 8% of firm revenue in 2001
V&E settled Enron-related litigation for $30 million without admitting wrongdoing
Represented Stonepeak in financing and acquiring a 50% stake in the 2.6 GW Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind project — named Project Finance International 2024 Americas Deal of the Year
Advised Talen Energy Corporation on a 1,920 MW power purchase agreement with Amazon Web Services
Represented New Fortress Energy in its $1.055 billion sale to Excelerate Energy
Core practices: Energy, Project Finance, M&A, Capital Markets, Private Equity, Litigation, Tax, Real Estate, Restructuring, Environmental, International Arbitration
